description: Google: Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter. Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's most intelligent Flash model with significant gains from 3.7 Flash across software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning.
sources: data/outcomes/REPORT_attempts.md (attempt-and-grade IRT; judge deepseek-v4.1-flash validated vs kimi-k3.1-pro)
data/outcomes/REPORT_v4_attempts.md (attempt-and-grade IRT v4, 9 attempters; judges deepseek-v4.1-flash ds-think / dsh)
notes: AA coding 76.3 (high), intelligence 40.9, agentic 40.2; coding index suggests 8.3, II suggests 7.6; averaged. Prices are OpenRouter list prices (per-token x 1e6) from /api/v1/models on 2026-10-25; they can differ per upstream provider. Context/max output are the top provider values. Latency is estimated: OpenRouter exposes no latency/throughput stats in the public API. Non-coding skill axes derived from coding theta with fixed offsets (tweaked per model), not measured. verified (attempt-grade 2026-10): axes data_analysis 7.7->6.92, planning 7.8->6.46, reasoning 7.9->6.99 fitted (1PL IRT, router scale) from single-turn, no-tool attempts on non-SWE tasks, graded by deepseek-v4.1-flash (kappa 0.85 vs kimi-k3.1-pro); applied only where the direction also holds under gpt-6.1-sol grading. Location anchored on the 5 attempters' own card means (deltas are relative to their consensus). Other axes and supersedes unchanged. See data/outcomes/REPORT_attempts.md. verified (attempt-grade v4): axes review 7.8->7.11 fitted (1PL IRT, router scale) from single-turn, no-tool attempts on non-SWE tasks, graded by deepseek-v4.1-flash (ds-think, kappa 0.85 vs kimi-k3.1-pro; dsh harness for the rest, kappa 0.75 vs ds-think); for the 5 OpenRouter models applied only where the direction also holds under gpt-6.1-sol grading. Location anchored on the 9 attempters' own card means (deltas are relative to their consensus). Other axes and supersedes unchanged. See data/outcomes/REPORT_v4_attempts.md.
